novelty.justification: The novelty route is a new measurement and prediction: the claim proposes a "graded, monotonic 'harm magnitude' scalar" that is "largely orthogonal to jailbreak perturbations," rather than another binary refusal direction. Searches using “LLM continuous harm severity activation geometry,” “ordinal harmfulness probe residual stream,” and “persistent harmful features jailbreak detection” identify the closest work as Robust Harmful Features Under Jailbreak Attacks (2026), which already proposes reading persistent safety activations after successful jailbreaks for robust detection, alongside Safety Beyond the Interface (2026) on latent-state harm probes and The Geometry of Refusal (2025) on multidimensional refusal geometry. Moving from those binary harmfulness signals to an ordinal severity axis and calibrated magnitude is a substantive change in measurement and unit of analysis, but it is a natural extension—not a new core jailbreak-robustness mechanism—because persistent internal harm signals and activation-based monitoring are already explicit in the closest work.
